d:
Best friends Kreshna & Vijay Sethupathi get together for a fun folk number called 'Paadatta Paadatta'. Sung by Velmurugan and Hariharasudhan, this number is all about enjoying life and living for the moment. SS Thaman gives this song a fun twist along with Yugabharathi's lyrics.
Song Name - Paadatta Paadatta
Movie - Vanmham
Singer - Velmurugan & Hariharasudhan
Music - SS Thaman
Lyrics - Yugabharathi
Director - Jaykrishna
Starring - Vijay Sethupathi, Kreshna, Sunaina
